plugins.name: Krypt Sampler
plugins.description: Plays a sample across the keyboard (C4 / MIDI 60 = original pitch unless the WAV has a root key) with windowed-sinc resampling, AHDSR envelope, filter, pitch envelope, reverse and loop. One-shot ignores note length (unless Loop is on). Start/End pick the region (slices; End <= Start is silent; reverse plays End to Start). Per-note Mod X/Y offset cutoff/resonance. The default drum/one-shot channel.

plugins.name: Audio Clip
plugins.description: Plays a sample in sync with playlist audio clips (no key tracking, high-quality sample-rate conversion). Stretch: time-stretch (Stretch × source BPM / project BPM when Follow tempo is on) and pitch-shift in semitones with optional formant preservation, rendered in the background (Signalsmith Stretch); the clip is silent until a new timing is ready. Created automatically when audio is dropped on the playlist.

plugins.name: Krypt TriOsc
plugins.description: Three-oscillator subtractive synth (sine/triangle/saw/square/pulse/noise). Detune spread doubles each oscillator into a detuned stereo pair; drift adds analog wander. Filter envelope ±7 octaves (scaled by velocity); per-note Mod X/Y offset cutoff/resonance. Two LFOs (incl. sample & hold, smooth random; Hz or synced 1/32 to 8 bars; song-locked or retrigger; fade in), one destination each. Amount 100 % = pitch ±12 st, cutoff ±4 oct, full tremolo or pan, ±30 ct detune, osc 1/2 crossfade. The default melodic synth.

plugins.name: Krypt 808
plugins.description: Tuned 808 / kick synth: sine body with pitch sweep, click, drive and long decay. Key-tracked at true pitch (C2 = MIDI 36 = 65.4 Hz): write 808 lines around C1-C3. Overlapping notes glide when the channel is mono with glide (slide notes always glide). Note length: One-shot rings for Decay; Gate releases at note off.

plugins.name: Krypt DrumSynth
plugins.description: Synthesized drum voice (kick, snare, clap, closed/open hat, tom, rim, cowbell, crash, perc) with tune, decay, tone, snap and drive. One-shot; keys transpose relative to C4 (MIDI 60). Decay is scaled per voice (hats shorter, open hat/crash longer) so 250 ms suits every voice. No samples needed.

plugins.name: Krypt EQ
plugins.description: 7-band parametric EQ: low cut, low shelf, 3 bells, high shelf, high cut (12/24/48 dB/oct). Analog-matched gain at each band's frequency, zero latency, smooth under automation.

plugins.name: Krypt Comp
plugins.description: Feed-forward compressor with soft knee, peak or RMS detection, auto makeup (adds back the average gain reduction over ~1.5 s, so loudness stays about level) and an optional sidechain input (falls back to its own input if none is routed). Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Limiter
plugins.description: Lookahead brickwall limiter (2 ms lookahead, 2.5 ms latency). With True peak on, the ceiling also holds for inter-sample peaks (4x oversampled detection). The master bus default.

plugins.name: Krypt Clipper
plugins.description: Soft/hard clipper with oversampling (2x: 35 samples latency, 4x: 41) to keep the clipping clean. Softness 0 is a hard clip; output never exceeds the ceiling. Loud drums without pumping.

plugins.name: Krypt Reverb
plugins.description: Algorithmic reverb: Room and Hall (dense diffused feedback delay network) and Plate (classic plate tank). Outputs 100% wet; the slot's mix knob sets the blend (default 25%). Decay is RT60 in seconds; damping and low cut shape the tail.

plugins.name: Krypt Delay
plugins.description: Tempo-synced stereo / ping-pong delay (bar divisions follow the time signature, up to 16 s) with filtered, softly saturated feedback and tape-style wow. Outputs echoes only; the slot's mix knob sets the blend (default 25%).

plugins.name: Krypt Drive
plugins.description: Saturation and distortion: tape (soft), tube (asymmetric, even harmonics), hard clip, wavefolder and bitcrusher (bits + sample-rate reduction). 2x oversampling + ADAA keep it clean (35 samples latency). Partial level compensation: +6 dB of drive adds about +3 dB of level before saturation.

plugins.name: Krypt Filter
plugins.description: Resonant multimode filter (LP/HP 12 or 24 dB, band pass, notch) with drive and an LFO on cutoff (depth 1 = ±3 octaves). Synced LFO locks to the bar grid while playing. Fully open low pass with no LFO is bypassed, so the default is transparent.

plugins.name: Krypt Duck
plugins.description: Sidechain ducker. Tempo shape: pumps on every step of Rate, locked to the beat while playing (uses depth, curve, attack; curve 0 = snappy recovery, 1 = long pump). Sidechain follow: ducks when the sidechain input exceeds the threshold (uses depth, attack, release); passes audio unchanged if no sidechain is routed.

plugins.name: Krypt Utility
plugins.description: Gain, balance pan, stereo width (0 = mono, 1 = unchanged, 2 = extra wide), mono sum, per-channel polarity and a 5 Hz DC filter. All moves are click-free.

plugins.name: Krypt Analyzer
plugins.description: Spectrum, oscilloscope and loudness (LUFS / true peak) display. Passes audio through untouched.

plugins.name: Krypt FM
plugins.description: Four-operator FM synth: 8 algorithms (stack, pairs, one-to-many, additive), op 4 feedback, per-operator ratio (coarse x (1 + fine)), detune, level, velocity sensitivity and AHDSR. Default patch is an electric piano (pairs: 1:1 body + 14:1 tine); bells, basses, brass, organs and pads are a few knobs away. 2x oversampled, plus filter with envelope, vibrato, Mod X = cutoff, Mod Y = brightness.

plugins.name: Krypt Wave
plugins.description: Wavetable synth with five generated tables (basic shapes morph, PWM, vowel formants, harmonic sweep, digital sync/bitcrush), band-limited per octave. Position morphs through each table (env 2 and the LFO can move it); up to 8 unison voices with detune and stereo spread; sub oscillator; filter with env 2/LFO/key tracking. Env 2 cutoff amount is ±6 octaves, LFO ±3.

plugins.name: Krypt Chorus
plugins.description: Multi-voice chorus and ensemble: 1-6 modulated delay voices per side with staggered delays and rates. Stereo spread offsets the right side's LFOs (a mono source turns wide). Depth 1 sweeps up to ±5 ms. Low/high cut shape the wet signal only, so bass stays mono and tight. Has its own Mix (50% = classic chorus). Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Flanger
plugins.description: Flanger: a 0.1-10 ms delay swept exponentially by a sine or triangle LFO (free or tempo-synced to the bar), with positive or negative feedback for metallic or hollow tones. Stereo phase offsets the right LFO. Through-zero mode delays the dry signal 3 ms (that is its latency; 0 otherwise) and sweeps the wet tap through it for the classic jet cancellation; Delay is then ignored. Has its own Mix.

plugins.name: Krypt Phaser
plugins.description: Phaser with 4-12 allpass stages (stages/2 notches) swept around Centre by a sine LFO: depth 1 = ±2 octaves. Free rate or tempo-synced to the bar. Feedback (±) sharpens the peaks; Stereo phase offsets the right LFO. Has its own Mix (50% = deepest notches). Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Gate/Time
plugins.description: Tempo-locked time and volume patterns: half-time, stutters, triplet chops, tape stop, reverse, scratch, three gate rhythms, or Custom steps: up to 16 steps, each with a time mode (play, rolls, repeat, half speed, reverse, tape stop or start) and a level. Reads only from the past (no latency). Trigger Always runs on the bar grid while playing; Active param runs only while Active is on (automate it). Depth scales the time warp and the gate; Smoothing sets crossfades.

plugins.name: Krypt Vocoder
plugins.description: Filterbank vocoder, 8-40 bands. Default: this slot's input is the carrier (synth) and the sidechain is the voice; swap them, or use the internal saw, noise or saw + noise carrier (Internal pitch, MIDI note). With no sidechain routed, the input becomes the voice over the internal carrier. Carrier flatten evens out the carrier; Formant shift moves the carrier bands; Sibilance passes the voice's top end; Unvoiced swaps in noise on s/f/t sounds; Release tilt makes low bands smoother or snappier.

plugins.name: Krypt Transient
plugins.description: Transient shaper: Attack boosts (+) or softens (-) the start of every hit, Sustain lifts or shortens the tail. Works at any input level (no threshold). Attack window sets how long the onset counts as attack; Sustain window sets how long tails are tracked. Up to about +18/-30 dB. Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Squash
plugins.description: Aggressive 3-band upward and downward compressor (multiband squash): squashes loud parts (10:1 above -24 dB) and pulls quiet detail up (4:1 below -36 dB, up to +30 dB) in each band. Depth is a phase-coherent parallel mix, Time scales attack/release, Upward/Downward scale each half. Band gains and split points shape the tone. Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Imager
plugins.description: Multiband stereo width: low, mid and high bands each from 0% (mono) through 100% (unchanged) to 200% (extra wide). Low width 0% gives mono-compatible bass. Linkwitz-Riley crossovers keep mid and side phase-aligned, so the magnitude is flat at default. Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Tune
plugins.description: Real-time pitch correction for monophonic vocals and instruments (60-1000 Hz). Snaps to the nearest note of the Key and Scale. Retune speed 0 ms gives the hard robotic effect; 30-80 ms sounds natural. Humanize keeps vibrato and expression; Amount scales the correction. Formant-friendly pitch-synchronous shifting. Latency about 15 ms (reported for delay compensation).

plugins.name: Krypt Multisampler
plugins.description: Plays real recorded multisampled instruments (grand piano, acoustic drum kits, strings, brass, winds, mallets) from downloadable sound packs. Its sample is an SFZ mapping ('pack:<id>/<file>.sfz'): velocity layers with crossfades, round robin, release samples, choke groups and loops come from the pack. Load a pack preset (find_presets) instead of building one; the pack must be installed (list_packs). Knobs: gain, attack, release, velocity sensitivity, tone, tune, width.

plugins.name: Krypt Heat
plugins.description: Multiband saturator: splits into low / mid / high (Linkwitz-Riley, two split points) and drives each band into its own shape (soft, tube, tape, hard, fold, rectify, bitcrush; for bitcrush Drive lowers the bit depth) with its own level. Warm the lows without mud, crunch only the mids, add air to the top. Half of each band's drive is compensated. Mix is phase-coherent parallel saturation. 2x oversampling = 35 samples latency (4x: 41, Off: 0).

plugins.name: Krypt Tape Echo
plugins.description: Tape echo: tempo-synced (straight, dotted, triplet) or free time, feedback through a tape saturator (above 100% it builds into dub runaway), wow and flutter that bend the repeats' pitch, Age (darker, thinner repeats plus hiss), ping-pong, and Freeze to loop the last repeat forever. Mix is built in (default 35%; use 100% on a send). Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Grain
plugins.description: Granular delay and freeze: chops the incoming audio into grains (Size, Density per second) read from Delay ms ago, re-pitched (Pitch, ±24 st), scattered in time and stereo (Spray), some played backwards (Reverse chance), with Feedback. Freeze holds the buffer for endless textures. Spectral mode instead smears the sound's spectrum over time (Blur) and Freeze holds a chord as a pad (2048 samples latency). Deterministic. Mix is built in (default 50%).

plugins.name: Krypt Glue
plugins.description: VCA-style bus compressor that glues a drum bus, a mix bus or the master: switched ratio (2:1, 4:1, 10:1), attack (0.1-30 ms) and release (0.1-1.2 s or Auto, which recovers fast after peaks and slowly under steady compression). Sidechain HPF keeps the kick from pumping the bus; Range caps the gain reduction; Mix is parallel compression. Optional external sidechain input. Typical glue: 2:1, 10 ms or 30 ms attack, Auto release, 2-4 dB of reduction. Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt De-Esser
plugins.description: Split-band de-esser for vocals: everything above Frequency (4-10 kHz, usually 5-8 kHz) is compressed when it gets louder than Threshold, by at most Range dB; the body of the voice below the split is never touched. Listen solos the band it reacts to, to find the 's' sounds. Mix blends the reduction in. Typical: 6-7 kHz, 4-8 dB of reduction on the loudest 's'. Zero latency.

plugins.name: Krypt Slicer
plugins.description: Loop slicer: chops one sample into slices (at its hits, on a beat grid or by hand) and plays slice N on key First key + N - 1 at its recorded pitch, so a break replays at any tempo and rearranges note by note. Per-slice pitch, reverse and gain; one-shot or gate; Cut previous chokes the sounding slice. Slice markers live on the channel (slicer.* commands).

plugins.name: Krypt Rack
plugins.description: Instrument rack: parallel chains, each a stock instrument plus its own effects, picked per note by key and velocity zone and summed with per-chain volume, pan, mute and solo. Layer and split sounds, then drive any inner knob from 8 macros.

plugins.name: Krypt Drum Rack
plugins.description: Drum rack: one pad per note (C2 = 36 up, 4x4 view), each pad a chain with its own sampler or drum synth and effects, plus choke groups (a closed hat cuts the open hat). 8 macros reach any pad knob.

plugins.name: Krypt FX Rack
plugins.description: Effect rack: splits the input into parallel chains of stock effects and sums them (parallel compression, multiband-style splits, wet/dry blends). Per-chain volume, pan, mute and solo; 8 macros reach any inner knob. The slot mix is the rack's wet/dry.
